weight_basis: eligible market 24h BTC volume / eligible global 24h BTC volume

weight_fields.weight_ratio: decimal numeric ratio of eligible global 24h BTC volume; 0..1
weight_fields.weight_percent_decimal: percentage expressed as decimal; alias of weight_ratio

global_bpi.weighted: sum(price_usd * global weight_ratio) across all eligible global BTC/fiat markets
global_bpi.unweighted: arithmetic mean price_usd across all eligible global BTC/fiat markets

national_bpi.membership: exchange registry region equals selected region/country code
national_bpi.weighted: sum(price_usd * global_weight_ratio) / sum(global_weight_ratio) within selected region subset
national_bpi.unweighted: arithmetic mean price_usd within selected region subset
national_bpi.reason: exchange geography defines native scope; quote currency is presentation/FX metadata only

sanity_gate.price_consensus: median USD-normalized eligible BTC/fiat market price
sanity_gate.note: No market receives any Global BPI or BitAvg weight until every sanity gate passes.

native_bpi.membership: exchange registry region is one of native_bpi.regions; quote currency never determines native membership
native_bpi.weighted: renormalized eligible 24h BTC-volume weights within native-region exchanges
native_bpi.unweighted: arithmetic mean price_usd across eligible native-region exchange markets
